subject: one-metre-square section of a house wall of rough stone, on its own: a few large roughly squared stones with smaller ones and thin pinning stones between them, in pale lime mortar, one metre long, one metre tall and half a metre thick, seen at a three-quarter view; its two ends, its top and its bottom cut flat and square so sections stack and butt edge to edge; weathered grey stone with a little warm ochre in it and faint patches of lichen, the mortar recessed a little between the stones so each stone stands out
